results.title: What we offer | Queensland Police Service Recruiting
results.description:
[Skip to main content](https://www.policerecruit.qld.gov.au/what-we-offer#main-content)

- [![Facebook](https://www.policerecruit.qld.gov.au/modules/custom/qps_theme/images/facebook-f-brands-blue.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/QueenslandPolice/)
- [![Instagram](https://www.policerecruit.qld.gov.au/modules/custom/qps_theme/images/instagram-brands-blue.svg)](https://www.instagram.com/qldpolice/)
- [![Youtube](https://www.policerecruit.qld.gov.au/modules/custom/qps_theme/images/youtube-brands-blue.svg)](https://www.youtube.com/user/QueenslandPolice)

- An additional $183 fortnightly recruit training allowance.
- Your policing service is recognised through allocation of a higher pay point than that of a mainstream recruit applicant. You may be paid at your determined pay point from the date of your commencement at the academy as a recruit. Your commencement pay point will be reflective of a range of factors including but not limited to length of policing service; relevancy, recency and type of policing experience, primarily in terms of frontline general duties; transferability of policing skills, knowledge, and experience to the role of a General Duties police officer; operational needs of the QPS, and in accordance with the [QPS Certified Agreement 2025](https://www.qirc.qld.gov.au/documents/3581). Please note the following: Recruit training period/s is not included in pay point recommendations. It is acknowledged some jurisdictions have various training frameworks, so in these instances consideration is given on a case-by-case basis. Qualifications (including degrees and designations) do not contribute to a higher pay point.

- How much do Queensland police recruits and officers earn?

Mainstream recruits are paid 70% of a First Year Constable (FYC) base salary (as outlined in the QPS Certified Agreement), as well the $183/fortnight recruit training allowance financial incentive. This boosts the training salary to approximately $60,000 per annum.

Note, recruits with previous policing experience may be eligible for higher pay point from day one at the academy.

The starting salary of a First Year Constable is approximately $94,530* per annum, comprising $78,124* + 21% Operational Shift Allowance (OSA), which is a fortnightly allowance paid to employees who equitably participate in a two or three-shift roster over seven days per week.

NOSA is 20% of the employee's base rate per shift, and is in addition to the OSA. It is paid to employees on OSA for the duration of each shift worked commencing on or between the hours of 6pm and 2am Monday to Sunday, including public holidays.

- overtime paid for work beyond rostered hours

+61 7 3015 3388 (for overseas enquiries)

- Tactical Crime Squad | | Stations | 340 (2025)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Police_Service#cite_note-1) | | Website | | [[www.police.qld.gov.au](http://www.police.qld.gov.au)](http://www.police.qld.gov.au/) | As of 2026, the QPS employs over 18,000 personnel, including 13,000 police officers and 5,000 staff members. ## Ranks and structure [ [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Queensland_Police_Service&action=edit§ion=11)] [![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9b/Queensland_Police_Officer_in_uniform.jpg/250px-Queensland_Police_Officer_in_uniform.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Queensland_Police_Officer_in_uniform.jpg) A Queensland Police officer in standard uniform The Queensland Police Service has two classes of uniformed personnel: police officers ('sworn' and 'unsworn'),[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Police_Service#cite_note-57) and staff members (public servants, including police liaison officers, watchhouse officers, protective services officers and pipes and drums musicians). As of 2015 all police officer rank insignia changed to an 'ink blue' background with insignia embroidered in white. There has been the addition of a 'recognition of service' horizontal bar between rank insignia and the words 'Queensland Police' for officers who have been on rank for a particular length of time. This 'recognition of service' is only for the ranks from senior constable to senior sergeant. [[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Police_Service#cite_note-58) In 2023 the rank of chief inspector was reintroduced into the Service. [[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Police_Service#cite_note-59)[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Police_Service#cite_note-:11-60) Rank insignia is worn only by uniformed officers. Prior to mid-2009, only officers at the rank of inspector and above (commissioned officers) had the words 'Queensland Police' embroidered on their [epaulettes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epaulette), however new uniform mandates saw the introduction of the words 'Queensland Police' on all epaulettes issued to police officers after this date. The epaulettes of commissioned officers are significantly larger than the epaulettes of lesser ranks. Different salary bands apply within the same rank commensurate with years of service. Officers relieving at a higher rank temporarily wear the epaulettes of the higher rank. Police [recruits](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Army_recruit) wear a light blue epaulette with embroidered 'POLICE RECRUIT'. Police recruits undertaking the PACE program wear a dark blue epaulette with no embroided text. Police officers and other members may be eligible to wear [Queensland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Honours) and [Australian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_honours_system) honours. ### Constable ranks [ [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Queensland_Police_Service&action=edit§ion=12)] ### Sergeant ranks [ [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Queensland_Police_Service&action=edit§ion=13)] ### Commissioned ranks [ [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Queensland_Police_Service&action=edit§ion=14)] | | | | | | | | | |-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-| | **Recruits, constables, sergeants[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queensland_Police_Service#cite_note-:11-60)** | | Recruit | Recruit
